climate: Most rain falls in winter. Dry summers keep mildew and rot down, though young vines may need watering.

blurb.text: A 283,300 acre AVA in Mendocino County, within the North Coast, spanning eight valleys including Anderson Valley, Potter Valley and Redwood Valley, with about 13 percent suitable for grapes. Sub-areas include Mendocino Ridge, Cole Ranch and McDowell Valley.
